name: Accessiy
author: CodeConfig

sections.description:
Accessiy is the #1 WordPress accessibility plugin to make your site more usable for everyone, especially people with disabilities. Designed with compliance and flexibility in mind, Accessiy offers a customizable interface with multiple tools to enhance readability, visual comfort, and navigational clarity.

👁️More Features | 👑Get Accessiy Pro | 📄Documentations | ⏯️Video Tutorials | 🎧Support

#1 Accessibility Plugin For WordPress. One Click Setup

No coding, no hassle – just install, activate, and you’re ready to go. With one-click setup and built-in mouse customization, creating an inclusive experience has never been this easy. Whether you’re a beginner or a pro, Accessiy helps make your site accessible for everyone in seconds.

♿ Accessibility Made Simple with Accessiy

1-Click Setup – Install and activate in seconds—no coding needed.
Custom Branding – Personalize the toolbar icon, size, border, and position to match your site.
Modular Control – Toggle individual features based on your site’s design and audience.
Responsive Design – Optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Blazing Fast – Lightweight and built without jQuery.
Multi-Language Support – Supports 35+ languages including all EU languages.
Modern UI – Sleek, user-friendly design that blends into any website.
Toolbar Placement Options – Position the toolbar differently on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Icon Customization – Choose icon style, adjust size, enable/disable borders.
GDPR Compliant – No user data collected; settings saved in localStorage.
Accessibility Statement Generator – Instantly create a compliance-ready statement for your site.

🗝️ Key Features

Content Adjustment

  • (FREE) Bigger Text – Increase font size for easier reading.
  • (FREE) Line Height – Adjust spacing between lines to improve clarity.
  • (FREE) Text Align – Toggle between left-aligned and justified text.
  • (FREE) Readable Font – Switch to a clean, legible font for better readability.
  • (PRO) Text Magnifier – Hover to magnify text for enhanced visibility.
  • (FREE) Highlight Links – Visually emphasize all links on the page.
  • (FREE) Cursor – Enlarge the cursor to make it easier to see.

Orientation Adjustment

  • (PRO) Page Structure – Highlight content structure to improve reading flow.
  • (PRO) Screen Reader – Read out text content for visually impaired users.
  • (PRO) Reading Mask – Dim surrounding content to focus on specific sections.
  • (PRO) Site Map – Show a structured view of page elements for easier navigation.
  • (PRO) Hide Images – Remove images to reduce visual distractions.
  • (FREE) Pause Animations – Stop moving elements like sliders or GIFs.
  • (PRO) Mute Sounds – Disable background audio for a quieter experience.
  • (FREE) Reading Line – Highlight a horizontal line to guide the reader’s eye.
  • (FREE) Outline Focus – Emphasize headings and focusable elements with outlines.

Color Adjustment

  • (PRO) Grayscale – Convert the page to black and white.
  • (PRO) Contrast – Adjust contrast levels for better visibility.
  • (PRO) Invert Colors – Invert colors for users with visual impairments.
  • (FREE) Brightness – Modify brightness to suit individual viewing needs.
  • (PRO) Saturation – Adjust color intensity across the page.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/accessiy directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Accessiy Settings in the dashboard to configure your preferences.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No! Accessiy is built for everyone — just install and activate. All features are point-and-click, with no coding required.

Is this plugin lightweight?

Yes. Accessiy is performance-optimized and built without jQuery. It’s designed to run smoothly alongside any WordPress theme or plugin without slowing down your website.

Does Accessiy help with WCAG & EAA compliance?

Yes. Accessiy is built to support accessibility best practices outlined in the WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) and helps prepare your site for EAA (European Accessibility Act) compliance.

In which languages is Accessiy available?

Accessiy supports 34+ languages including:
English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Finnish, Portuguese, Romanian, Slovenian, Slovak, Dutch, Danish, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Croatian, Irish, Bulgarian, Ukrainian, Turkish, and more.

Will I receive support if I encounter issues?

Absolutely. Our support team is available 24/7 to help you with installation, customization, or troubleshooting. Visit https://codeconfig.dev/contact/ to get assistance anytime.
